title: Top concerns/Top strengths enrichment (flags/positives) unpinned — reverting flags to "[]" fails no test
evidence: Template reads the sections from the payload, not extras (server/priv/templates/audit_report.typ:343,351,372): `#let top-flags = if data.flags.len() > 3 { data.flags.slice(0, 3) } else { data.flags }` / `#eyebrow(if data.flags.len() == 0 { "TOP CONCERNS" } else { "TOP CONCERNS · " + str(data.flags.len()) + " IDENTIFIED" })` / `#eyebrow(if data.positives.len() == 0 { "TOP STRENGTHS" } else { "TOP STRENGTHS · " + str(data.positives.len()) + " IDENTIFIED" })`. The pin's decoder (lines 84-96) covers only extras fields: `use insight <- decode.field("detailed_insight", decode.string)` / `use notes <- decode.field("category_notes", ...)` / `use recs <- decode.field("recommendations", ...)` / `use weights <- decode.field("category_weights", ...)` / `use summary <- decode.field("verification_summary", ...)` — no flags/positives anywhere; grep of client/test for `.flags`/`.positives` returns zero hits, so the demo_store screen-side arrays are also unasserted.
detail: Fix 2 touts enriched concerns/strengths (Aoife 0→3 concerns + 6 strengths) for the spec's named Top concerns/strengths sections and the 'contradictions included' requirement, yet only extras-driven sections are pinned. A future edit emptying flags ships 'No concerns identified.' empty-states with a green suite — polish-1's unpinned-enrichment failure mode.
recommended_fix: Extend pdf_report_data_test (or a payloads()-level test) to decode flags/positives per applicant: assert non-empty flags for all 8, severities in {red,amber}, and non-empty positives for scored applicants.

title: Banner-survival pin is one-sided — consent banner's own z-index/anchor (consent.js 2147483000) asserted nowhere
evidence:
Banner side: `"position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:2147483000;" +`. Toast pin (client/test/demo/demo_flow_test.gleam:1076-1080): `html
  |> string.contains("fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001]")
  |> should.be_true
  html |> string.contains("fixed bottom-4 right-4") |> should.be_false`. Grep for 2147483000 across server/test and client/test yields only comments — no test reads consent.js.
detail: The #615 guarantee is an inequality (toast 2147483001 above banner 2147483000). Only the toast side is pinned; bumping consent.js z-index to >=2147483001 silently breaks banner survival with all tests green. Position itself is well pinned; this is the banner-side residual.
recommended_fix: Add a server-side test reading priv/static/consent.js asserting z-index:2147483000 and bottom-anchoring, so both sides of the #615 inequality are pinned.

title: Client competition-ranks port: tie branch and NULLS-LAST/None branches have zero client-side coverage
detail: The ported logic claims to mirror the server exactly, but its tie arm is unreachable with current seed data (v-maples scores all distinct; no vacancy mixes scored+pending) and its None-tail arm (reachable via v-harbour) is untested. A divergence between port and original would not fail any client test.
recommended_fix: Add a unit test calling demo_store.competition_ranks directly with ties + None tail ([Some(70),Some(70),Some(40),None] → [Some(1),Some(1),Some(3),None]), mirroring the server's leaderboard_test cases.

title: Compare Top 3 click-through untested — render proof stops at button presence; no test dispatches UserClickedCompareTop3
detail: The spec's acceptance is 'renders AND works (opens the demo comparison)'; 'opens' is in-browser verified only. The handler is pre-existing shared code and its data dependency (top_three_ids output) is now pinned, so the residual is the top_ids→comparison_ids+navigation wiring.
recommended_fix: Add a demo test dispatching msg.UserClickedCompareTop3("v-maples") on a model with Success(leaderboard.entries); assert comparison_ids == ["a-aoife","a-conor","a-marta"].

title: Snapshot-row fixes (phone/tenure, Declan DM Plumbing income source, Aoife/Marta income-source removals) unpinned
evidence:
`    phone: Some(phone),` / `    employment_duration: Some(tenure),` and `"a-declan" -> [
      GetIncomeSourcesByApplicationRow(
        id: "inc-declan-1",
        source_type: "self_employed",
        amount_cents: 300_000,
        note: "Average monthly net from DM Plumbing",
      ),
    ]`. payloads() is now `pub` (line 325) but no test calls it; grep of server/test shows only documents_for referenced by pdf_report_data_test.gleam:108.
detail: The PR lists 'Application on File — fixed phone + time-in-role fields (were Not provided), Declan's DM Plumbing income now listed, Aoife's co-applicant income no longer double-counted' as fix bullets, yet no test asserts these snapshot fields; a revert to phone: None or dropped income rows fails nothing.
recommended_fix: Add a payloads()-level test asserting each row's phone/employment_duration are Some(_), a-declan carries exactly the DM Plumbing source, and a-aoife/a-marta carry no income sources.

title: documents-count-match assertion is self-referential — test passes the count in, then asserts it echoes back
detail: The assertion duplicates the production call instead of exercising it: to_report_data's wiring (pdf_prebake.gleam:605-608 `pdf_report_data.extras_for(p.application_id, list.length(documents_for(p.application_id)))`) could pass a wrong count and the test stays green. The pin's other assertions are substantive; this one is tautological.
recommended_fix: Assert against an independently stated expectation (e.g. a per-applicant expected doc-count table), or decode extras via pdf_prebake's to_report_data path instead of re-invoking extras_for directly.

title: Baked PDF artifacts unpinned — 13-15 page claim is in-browser only; a stale or thin re-bake fails no test
evidence: Diff entries: `Binary files a/server/priv/static/demo/report-a-aoife.pdf and b/server/priv/static/demo/report-a-aoife.pdf differ` (×8). Grep of server/test shows no test reading report-*.pdf — the only pins are on the generator inputs (pdf_report_data_test.gleam).
detail: Polish-1's failure was thin committed PDFs nobody caught; the fix pins extras data but not the artifacts, so PDFs can drift from the data (forgotten re-bake after a fixture edit) with a fully green suite.
recommended_fix: Add a lightweight artifact guard: assert each committed report-*.pdf exists and exceeds a floor size (or embed/assert a bake-manifest hash), with a documented regen command on failure.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 pins verified revert-green: toast position (`fixed top-20 right-4 z-[2147483001]` asserted through client.view, demo_flow_test.gleam:1076-1080), Compare gate inputs (ranks [Some(1)..Some(8)] + top_three_ids==3, demo_flow_test.gleam:979-1005) + render proof (compare-top-3-btn, :1041), report extras substance (insight>1200 chars, 6 notes w/ rationale>80+confidence+evidence, >=3 recs, weights, credit-check note — pdf_report_data_test.gleam:118-162). Gaps: flags/positives enrichment NONE (warning above), banner survival PARTIAL (one-sided), click-through PARTIAL, snapshot-row fixes NONE, tie/None port branches NONE.
detail: P0 100% — all three must-bite fixes carry real, non-tautological acceptance pins (the polish-1 vacuous-pin failure mode is fixed: gate test asserts the actual gate inputs and would fail on the old score-as-rank code). P1 ≈80% — the concerns/strengths section-group and the one-sided banner pin are the gaps. Overall ≈85% (bulk of the 2300-line diff is pinned extras data). CONCERNS band: P0 100%, P1 80-89%, overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Pin flags/positives substance per applicant (server payloads + client analyses) and add the consent.js z-index pin; that lifts P1 into PASS territory (≥90%).
